chunks: Then We sent to them an apostle from among them (who said): "Worship God, for you have no other god but He. Will you not take heed and fear God?"

key_terms.تَتَّقُونَ: you fear God / you take heed

ai.seo_question: What is the message of the prophet sent to the people in Surah Al-Mu'minun?
ai.summary: This verse encapsulates the fundamental prophetic mission of da'wah, highlighting the principle of 'minhum' (from among them) which underscores the prophet's relatability and shared humanity with his community, a key concept in Shia exegesis regarding the Imams' role as guides. It links the theological imperative of Tawhid (monotheism) directly to ethical conduct, urging believers to cultivate taqwa as the practical manifestation of recognizing God's exclusive sovereignty.
